content: The organisers of the MEDDOCAN shared task BIBREF3 curated a synthetic corpus of clinical cases enriched with sensitive information by health documentalists. In this regard, the MEDDOCAN evaluation scenario could be said to be somewhat far from the real use case the technology developed for the shared task is supposed to be applied in. However, at the moment it also provides the only public means for a rigorous comparison between systems for sensitive health information detection in Spanish texts.
